name: iflytek-skills
description: Run eight executable iFLYTEK AI skills through a local MCP server.
long_description: A local stdio MCP server for translation, proofreading, speech synthesis, image understanding, invoice OCR, image/PDF OCR, and speech transcription. Calls are executed by the corresponding scripts checked into iflytek/iFly-Skills.

tools.name: hyper_tts
tools.description: Synthesize speech with an iFLYTEK voice.

tools.name: ocr_invoice
tools.description: Extract fields from an invoice image.

tools.name: image_ocr
tools.description: Recognize text in a local image.

tools.name: pdf_ocr
tools.description: Submit and poll OCR for a local PDF.

allowed_directory.title: Allowed input directory
allowed_directory.description: Only files below this directory can be read by image, PDF, or audio tools.

iflytek_app_id.title: iFLYTEK App ID
iflytek_app_id.description: APPID from the iFLYTEK Open Platform application console.

iflytek_api_key.title: iFLYTEK API Key
iflytek_api_key.description: APIKey from the same iFLYTEK application.

iflytek_api_secret.title: iFLYTEK API Secret
iflytek_api_secret.description: APISecret from the same iFLYTEK application.
